# Bad Style Examples
# Demonstrates all CK33xx style validation errors

# ERROR CK3325: Namespace not at top of file (should be first)
style_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0001.t
	desc = style_bad.0001.desc
}

namespace = style_bad # ERROR CK3325: Should be at the top!

# ERROR CK3301: Inconsistent indentation
style_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
		title = style_bad.0002.t # Wrong indentation
	desc = style_bad.0002.desc
  trigger = { # Wrong indentation
		is_adult = yes
	}
 option = { # Wrong indentation
		name = style_bad.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
}
}

# ERROR CK3303: Spaces instead of tabs
style_bad.0003 = {
    type = character_event # ERROR: Indented with spaces
    title = style_bad.0003.t # ERROR: Indented with spaces
    desc = style_bad.0003.desc # ERROR: Indented with spaces

    trigger = { # ERROR: Indented with spaces
        is_adult = yes # ERROR: Indented with spaces
    } # ERROR: Indented with spaces

    option = { # ERROR: Indented with spaces
        name = style_bad.0003.a # ERROR: Indented with spaces
        add_gold = 100 # ERROR: Indented with spaces
    } # ERROR: Indented with spaces
} # ERROR: Indented with spaces

# ERROR CK3304: Trailing whitespace (spaces at end of lines)
style_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0004.t
	desc = style_bad.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0004.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3305: Block content not indented
style_bad.0005 = {
type = character_event # ERROR: Should be indented
title = style_bad.0005.t # ERROR: Should be indented
desc = style_bad.0005.desc # ERROR: Should be indented

trigger = { # ERROR: Should be indented
is_adult = yes # ERROR: Should be indented
} # ERROR: Should be indented

option = { # ERROR: Should be indented
name = style_bad.0005.a # ERROR: Should be indented
add_gold = 100 # ERROR: Should be indented
} # ERROR: Should be indented
}

# ERROR CK3306: Inconsistent operator spacing
style_bad.0006 = {
	type= character_event # ERROR: No space before =
	title =style_bad.0006.t # ERROR: No space after =
	desc=style_bad.0006.desc # ERROR: No spaces around =

	trigger = {
		is_adult= yes # ERROR: No space before =
		age>=16 # ERROR: No spaces around >=
		gold >=100 # ERROR: No space after >=
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0006.a
		add_gold=100 # ERROR: No spaces around =
	}
}

# ERROR CK3307: Closing brace misalignment
style_bad.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0007.t
	desc = style_bad.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		} # ERROR: Misaligned closing brace

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0007.a
		add_gold = 100
			} # ERROR: Misaligned closing brace
	} # ERROR: Misaligned closing brace

# ERROR CK3302: Multiple statements on one line
style_bad.0008 = {
	type = character_event title = style_bad.0008.t desc = style_bad.0008.desc # ERROR: Multiple statements

	trigger = { is_adult = yes is_ruler = yes gold >= 100 } # ERROR: Multiple statements

	option = { name = style_bad.0008.a add_gold = 100 add_prestige = 50 } # ERROR: Multiple statements
}

# ERROR CK3314: Empty block detected
style_bad.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0009.t
	desc = style_bad.0009.desc

	trigger = {
		# ERROR CK3314: Empty trigger block
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3314: Empty immediate block
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0009.a
		# ERROR CK3314: Only has name, no effects
	}
}

# ERROR CK3316: Line exceeds length (>120 characters typically)
style_bad.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0010.t
	desc = style_bad.0010.desc

	trigger = {
		# ERROR CK3316: Line way too long
		is_adult = yes is_ruler = yes is_landed = yes has_trait = brave has_trait = ambitious has_trait = greedy gold >= 100 prestige >= 200 piety >= 150 age >= 25 diplomacy >= 10 martial >= 10
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0010.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3317: Deeply nested blocks (>5 levels)
style_bad.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0011.t
	desc = style_bad.0011.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					prestige >= 50
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						piety >= 25
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							age >= 30
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_ruler = yes
							}
							# ERROR CK3317: Too deeply nested (6+ levels)
							add_gold = 1000
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0011.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3308: Missing blank line between sections
style_bad.0012 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0012.t
	desc = style_bad.0012.desc
	trigger = { # ERROR: No blank line before trigger
		is_adult = yes
	}
	immediate = { # ERROR: No blank line before immediate
		save_scope_as = actor
	}
	option = { # ERROR: No blank line before option
		name = style_bad.0012.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
	option = { # ERROR: No blank line before option
		name = style_bad.0012.b
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3340: Suspicious scope reference
style_bad.0013 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0013.t
	desc = style_bad.0013.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
		# ERROR CK3340: Suspicious - looks like incomplete scope reference
		scop:actor = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0013.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3341: Truncated scope reference
style_bad.0014 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0014.t
	desc = style_bad.0014.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = my_liege_character
		# ERROR CK3341: Scope name looks truncated
		scope:my_lie = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0014.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3345: Merged identifier (no space before {)
style_bad.0015 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0015.t
	desc = style_bad.0015.desc

	trigger ={ # ERROR CK3345: No space before {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate={ # ERROR CK3345: No space before {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option={ # ERROR CK3345: No space before {
		name = style_bad.0015.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Multiple style errors combined
style_bad.0016 = {
type= character_event # ERROR CK3305, CK3306: Not indented, no space before =
    title = style_bad.0016.t # ERROR CK3303: Spaces instead of tabs
desc=style_bad.0016.desc # ERROR CK3305, CK3306: Not indented, no spaces around =
trigger={ is_adult= yes is_ruler =yes } # ERROR CK3302, CK3306, CK3345: Multiple statements, bad spacing, merged identifier
	option = { name = style_bad.0016.a add_gold = 100 add_prestige = 50 } # ERROR CK3302: Multiple statements
		} # ERROR CK3307: Misaligned closing brace

# ERROR CK3314: Multiple empty blocks
style_bad.0017 = {
	type = character_event
	title = style_bad.0017.t
	desc = style_bad.0017.desc

	trigger = {
		# Empty
	}

	immediate = {
		# Empty
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0017.a
		# Empty (only name)
	}

	option = {
		name = style_bad.0017.b
		# Empty (only name)
	}
}

# ERROR: Inconsistent indentation throughout
style_bad.0018 = {
	type = character_event
			title = style_bad.0018.t # Too much indentation
 desc = style_bad.0018.desc # Too little indentation

	trigger = {
  is_adult = yes # Wrong indentation
				is_ruler = yes # Way too much indentation
	}

		option = { # Too much indentation
	name = style_bad.0018.a # Too little indentation
			add_gold = 100 # Too much indentation
	}
}
